messages.model.privacy3: Only use an endpoint you trust. Your provider or its upstream services may retain request data under their own policies. Your key is accessible in browser memory and developer tools, and BuildY cannot protect it from a compromised device, malicious extensions, or third-party logging outside our control.
messages.model.privacy4: BuildY does not log request headers, request bodies, or raw provider errors. Secret headers such as Authorization and x-user-api-key are excluded from any diagnostics we control. Connection-test results are redacted and are not saved to your project.
messages.model.privacy5: Test connection sends one short request to this provider and may incur charges. Nothing is sent automatically when you add a model. A successful text test does not guarantee support for streaming, tools, or structured output. Browser access also depends on the provider's CORS policy and this deployment's security policy.
